tasks.summary:
I built `toolkit synth` and generated three seeded synthetic datasets for northwind-demo at /home/cloudcli/sourcecode/access-excel-to-django/northwind/goldens/synthetic/seed-{1,2,3}/input/. All eight acceptance commands passed. Each seed has 28 tables and 1030 rows. The 'dataset validate' check found no problems and no foreign-key orphans, and 'synth --check' found 0 differences. The guard found 0 failures across 341 files.

Sources: the tool reads only the scrubbed model (schema, objects, procedures, data macros and the code files that procedures.json lists) and the lookups in rules.json. A test confirms that no data-zone path and nothing else is opened.

Lookup codes: codes for lookups marked copy_values come from the model. That means value lists (Employees.Title, PaymentMethod), literals in query criteria, and VBA comparisons where enum members resolve to their numbers. Each status enum gives its lookup table one row per code: OrderStatus 5, OrderDetailStatus 6, PurchaseOrderStatus 5, TaxStatus 0/1, Privileges 1 and SystemSettings 5 (ids 1,4,5,6,7). No rules.json `values` were needed. Only CompanyTypes.CompanyType is named as generated: the model holds one code for it, but the column is unique across 4 rows, so the other 3 codes were generated.

Every other column gets Faker values from a per-column stream seeded from sha256(seed, table, column), plus the model literals that filters compare it with. Each literal and each lookup code appears at least once in every seed. Dates stay between 2023-01-01 and 2025-12-31 and include weekends and month ends.

How the seeds differ: seed 1 is plain. Seed 2 adds NULLs in every nullable column, empty strings where the column allows them, zero and negative numbers where the validation rule allows, maximum-length text, the first and last second of the date window, non-ASCII text, and quotes, commas and line breaks. Seed 3 adds duplicates and gives up to 12 lines to one order.

The new test file has 28 tests, all passing.
notes: Full toolkit suite (uv run pytest -q toolkit): 523 passed, 3 failed. The 3 failures are in toolkit/tests/test_dataset.py (test_data_copy_needs_the_bridge, test_accdb_source_needs_the_bridge, test_open_backend). They expect the Jackcess bridge to be missing, but another task has added the untracked toolkit/reference/ in the pipeline worktree. They are not caused by synth files; S2.reference or the integrate step should reconcile them.

Assumption: a VBA enum is the code list of the columns it is compared with, and of the table its name names: enumOrderStatus maps to OrderStatus, and enumNorthwindFeaturesOpenMethod to NorthwindFeatures.OpenMethod. So every member of the enum becomes a code, not only the members the code compares directly. A code that does not fit the column is dropped, for example 0 (ctAll) for the autonumber CompanyTypes.CompanyTypeID.

Assumption: a text literal counts as a code only if it has at most 40 characters and 4 words, so VBA message texts never reach the committed seeds. Properties of runtime objects such as Err.Description are ignored.
Assumption: an autonumber key on a lookup table takes the codes as its ids. That is why SystemSettings has ids 1,4,5,6,7. All other autonumber keys run 1..n.

Assumption: in seed 2, a unique index allows at most one NULL key, so the seeds also load on SQL Server. Empty strings appear only where AllowZeroLength allows them. Values never break simple validation rules, so OrderDetails.Quantity is always above 0 and the StockTake quantities never go below 0.
Literals from saved table filters on Orders, OrderDetails and Strings are not used. The spec names query criteria, VBA comparisons and list validations; table Filter properties are datasheet state.

qrySales_SalesRep filters on the current year, so it selects no rows on any seed: the dates stop at 2025-12-31 and synth never uses the current date. S2.golden should pin the date through params or record an empty result.

SystemSettings.SettingValue is generated text. If app or reference logic parses the tax-rate setting as a number, it will need a numeric value. Question for the client or S2.reference: should the seed give the tax-rate settings numeric values?
The seeds depend on the pinned Faker version (faker==40.43.0). An upgrade regenerates the seeds and then the goldens through the normal record path.
No golden files were changed. Only seed-N/input directories were written; goldens/synthetic/seed-N/expected belongs to golden record.

issues.problem: The reference engine gets Nz() wrong, so the kept unit qryPurchaseOrderList has wrong goldens. Its design (and rule R-purchasing-025) defines TotalCost = Nz(ExtendedCost)+Nz(ShippingFee)+Nz(TaxAmount), with missing parts counted as zero. The engine sends this SQL to UCanAccess unchanged, and UCanAccess's Nz rounds each non-null currency or decimal argument to a whole number before adding. Access returns a non-null argument unchanged. As a result every seed-1 expected TotalCost is the sum of three rounded integers instead of the exact cents total. The engagement golden is presumably recorded with the same error; it cannot be inspected from the design zone. The reference adapter still passes 100% only because the goldens and the adapter come from the same faulty engine. The catalog marks the unit needs_access_confirmation false. It also does not handle Access's query-context Nz(Null), which returns a zero-length string; that case occurs on 4 of 14 seed-1 rows, the purchase orders with no lines.

Per purchase order, expected TotalCost equals round(cost)+round(fee)+round(tax) every time, e.g. PO 1: 20142+32+66=20240 against the exact 20239.12; PO 10: 34+8=42 against 42.11. My other 9 recomputed units all match: qryInvoice, qryOrderTotal, qryProductList, qryrptSalesByEmployee, qryrptSalesByProduct_ByQuarter, qrycboProducts, qryEmployeeSupervisor, qryrptProductCatalog. issues.problem: The ProductToSell rewrite takes Max(QuantityOnHand) when several stock-take rows share a product's latest StockTakeDate. VBA (ProductLastStockTakeQuantity, a DLookup) returns whichever matching row comes first, so on duplicate dates the rewrite fixes one answer where Access's answer is undefined. The rewrite cites R-inventory-005, and it otherwise matches the VBA semantics: last stock take, else AddedOn, else Now(); bought from ReceivedDate >= that date; sold by InvoiceDate >= that date with nulls excluded; minus allocated. Seed 3 adds duplicates on purpose, so this tie-break should be recorded as an assumption or a client question, not left implicit.
issues.evidence: northwind/goldens/reference/functions/ProductToSell.json, rewrite field: 'SELECT Max(ft_s0.QuantityOnHand) ... AND ft_s0.StockTakeDate = (SELECT Max(...))'. The VBA it replaces is modInventory.ProductLastStockTakeQuantity in /home/cloudcli/engagements/northwind-demo/private/out/model/code/modInventory.txt, which uses a DLookup on the matching date. Neither R-inventory-001 nor R-inventory-005 in analysis/rules.json mentions ties.

issues.problem: Seed 1 puts no order lines in the default report period (R-reports-003). So qryrptSalesByProduct_ByMonth and qryrptSalesByProduct_ByQuarter are empty on seed-1, and both seed-1 qryrptSalesByEmployee rows have a NULL OrderTotal. The Format, grouping and summing in the report units is therefore barely exercised on seed-1.
issues.evidence: golden record --dataset all --check (exit 0) reports seed-1.empty 2 for the ByMonth and ByQuarter units. My recomputation finds 2 orders in the seed-1 report period, neither with order lines. northwind/goldens/synthetic/seed-1/expected/qryrptSalesByEmployee.csv has OrderTotal \N on both rows.

issues.problem: Redacted runs do not refuse or neutralise the output paths that skip pytest's capture: `-s`/`--capture=no` and live logging (`log_cli=true` in an ini file). On the engagement dataset, a print or log record from the adapter or app would then go straight to the terminal. Neither the docstring promise in harness/redact.py nor the canary test covers these paths. The toolkit's own argv never passes them, and mp-data shows only a JSON summary, so the mp-data path is safe today. The gap matters when someone re-runs the vendored copy by hand, or when the S4 Django project's pytest config turns on log_cli.
